formulas.boards: Boards = (ceiling area × layers + trough board + partition faces × layers) ÷ board area × (1 + waste), rounded up
formulas.cRuns: C runs = (W ÷ C spacing) + 1 per room, each L long; cut onto bars with least waste
formulas.omegaRuns: Omega runs = (L ÷ omega spacing) + 1 per room, each W long + extra omega for troughs; cut onto bars
formulas.cGrid: C lines inside each room at the grid spacing, the first one spacing from the wall (the edge angle carries the wall side), the cheaper way; pieces cut onto bars, offcuts shared between rooms
formulas.omegaGrid: Omega lines at the same grid spacing across the C, the first one spacing from the wall + extra omega for troughs; cut onto bars
formulas.cQuick: ceiling area ÷ grid spacing (estimate), onto bars
formulas.omegaQuick: ceiling area ÷ grid spacing + extra omega for troughs (estimate), onto bars
formulas.rods: Rods = hangers × (hanging height + cutting allowance), cut onto rods
formulas.vhangers: Vertical hangers = hangers × (hanging height + cutting allowance), cut onto C bars
formulas.clips: One clip at each C × omega crossing
formulas.edgeEst: Estimated perimeter = area × 0.7, cut onto bars
formulas.edgeRooms: Room sides cut onto angle bars
formulas.troughAngle: Trough m × protection angle per m
formulas.shadow: Shadow length cut onto profile bars
formulas.screws: Board m² × layers × screws per m² × (1 + waste)
formulas.tape: Finished m² × tape per m² × (1 + waste) ÷ roll length
formulas.compound: Finished m² × compound per m² × (1 + waste) ÷ bag weight
formulas.paint: Quantity = area × coats ÷ (coverage per litre × surface factor) × (1 + waste), then the cheapest pack mix
formulas.team: Days = area ÷ team productivity per day, × crew daily cost
formulas.extLump: Subcontractor lump sum split by area
formulas.missing: No complete product for this line (needs pack size, coverage and price)

contract.intro: On {date}, this agreement is made between:
contract.preamble: Whereas the second party wishes to carry out {work} works at the location above, and whereas the first party is an establishment specialised in finishing works with the experience and means to carry them out, the parties, being of full legal capacity, have agreed as follows:
contract.s_annexBody: The preamble is an integral part of this contract, and quotation no. {quote} is an annex to it. In case of conflict, this contract prevails.
contract.s_scope_full: The first party shall supply and install the following works:
contract.s_scope_labour: The first party shall carry out the following works; the second party supplies the materials:
contract.s_scope_supply: The first party shall supply the materials for the following works, without installation:
contract.s_specsBody: Works are carried out to the following specifications, good trade practice and the manufacturers' instructions:
contract.s_valueNoVat: Total contract value {total}, not subject to VAT.
contract.s_valueUnit: Final settlement is on the actual executed and approved quantities after measurement, at the unit prices in the scope of works.
contract.s_valueLump: The value is a lump sum for the scope defined in this contract.
contract.s_paymentsBody: The second party shall pay the contract value in the following instalments, each due when its stage is reached:
contract.s_paymentsLate: If any due payment is more than 7 days late after notice, the first party may suspend work, and the duration is extended by the suspension period.
contract.s_durationBody: The duration is {days} days starting {start}, with expected completion on {end}. It is extended for additional works, delays by the second party in its obligations or payments, or circumstances beyond the first party's control.
contract.s_durationLabour: The first party is not responsible for delays caused by late supply of materials by the second party.
contract.o1_execute: Carry out the works to the agreed specifications with qualified labour under technical supervision.
contract.o1_supply: Supply the materials of the types and brands in the specifications.
contract.o1_safety: Follow safety procedures and protect the property on site.
contract.o1_clean: Clean its debris from the site at handover.
contract.o1_warranty: Repair any workmanship defects that appear during the warranty at no cost.
contract.o2_site: Hand over the site ready and clear on the start date, and give the first party access.
contract.o2_utilities: Provide water and electricity on site throughout the works.
contract.o2_approve: Approve colours and samples on time so the work is not delayed.
contract.o2_materials: Supply the required materials in the quantities and specifications needed, on time.
contract.s_handoverBody: The first party notifies the second party when each stage is complete; the second party has 3 days from notice to inspect and give written remarks, otherwise the stage is deemed accepted. Final acceptance is by a handover certificate.
contract.s_additionalBody: Any work outside this scope, or change to it, is carried out only under a written addendum approved by the second party before starting, stating its value, duration and separate payment.
contract.s_warrantyBody: The first party warrants the works against workmanship defects for {n} months from final acceptance. The warranty excludes damage from misuse, leaks, structural cracks or works by others.
contract.s_terminationBody: If either party breaches its obligations and does not remedy the breach within 15 days of written notice, the other party may terminate. In all cases the first party is entitled to the value of works executed and materials supplied up to termination.
contract.s_forceBody: Neither party is liable for delays caused by force majeure or circumstances beyond its control; the duration is extended accordingly.
contract.s_noticesBody: Messages by WhatsApp, email and the project's online page, to the parties' details above, are valid notices.
contract.s_lawBody: This contract is governed by the Civil Transactions Law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are settled amicably, failing which the competent court in {city} has jurisdiction.
contract.s_lawBodyNoCity: This contract is governed by the Civil Transactions Law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are settled amicably, failing which the competent courts of the Kingdom have jurisdiction.
contract.s_signingBody: This contract is made electronically; the second party's acceptance through its private link is a binding signature under the Electronic Transactions Law, and each party keeps a copy.

qoyod.title: Qoyod accounting
qoyod.intro: Everything starts here: services, clients, suppliers, invoices and payments — the app creates them in Qoyod automatically, so you never add anything there by hand. An invoice for each payment requested from a client, a receipt for every amount received, and a bill for each purchase. Qoyod issues the official e-invoice, and the client opens it from their page.
qoyod.step1: Sign in to Qoyod → Settings → General Settings.
qoyod.step2: Generate an API key and save the settings there.
qoyod.step3: Paste the key here and tap “Connect & test” — the app checks it, prepares Qoyod automatically (warehouse, accounts and your service products) and starts sending as drafts.
qoyod.setupHint: Prepared automatically from your Qoyod account. You can change any choice, but usually you won't need to.
qoyod.inventoryHint: Qoyod requires it on every invoice
qoyod.receiveHint: The bank or cash account client payments go into
qoyod.expenseHint: Purchase bills are posted to it

qoyod.draftHint: Recommended at first: invoices arrive in Qoyod as drafts; you review and approve them there.
qoyod.approvedHint: Invoices are approved at once and reported to ZATCA — use once the settings are verified.
qoyod.enableHint: When paused, nothing is sent or queued.

qoyod.salaryHint: The monthly payroll entry is posted to this (expense) account against the bank — sent once sending is “Approved”.
qoyod.cashHint: For supplier bills paid in cash and petty-cash expenses, and for petty-cash top-up / return entries (bank ↔ cash). It can't be the bank account. Without it, petty cash and cash bills are paid from the bank account itself. Whenever you choose, change or clear it (or switch sending on), one «Petty-cash balance adjustment» entry posts only the difference, so the cash account in Qoyod always equals the real petty-cash balance.
qoyod.waiting_approved: Waiting for sending to be “Approved” — payments and entries aren't posted on drafts.
qoyod.skipped_same_account: Nothing to post: no cash account is set, so petty cash is paid from the bank account itself (same account).
qoyod.skipped_same_account_reconcile: Nothing to post: the adjustment's two accounts became the same (the old cash account is now the bank account).
qoyod.waiting_bill: Waiting for the purchase bill to be sent first.
qoyod.subcontractHint: Payments to subcontractors are posted in Qoyod as an expense bill on this account, then paid from the bank or cash. If empty, the purchases & expenses account is used.
qoyod.waiting_invoice_draft: The invoice is a draft in Qoyod — approve it there and the payment is sent automatically.
qoyod.draftCount: Invoices waiting for your approval in Qoyod: {n} (their numbers show to users with finance access).
qoyod.draftListHint: These invoices were sent to Qoyod as drafts and their payments are waiting. Qoyod's API can't approve an existing invoice, so open each one in Qoyod and approve it, then tap “Approved — send now” and the payments are sent right away. (Purchase bills are approved automatically before they are paid.)
qoyod.approvedSent: Done — the waiting payments are being sent to Qoyod
qoyod.rewardHint: Rewards are recorded as an expense bill on this account, then paid. Without one they go to the purchases & expenses account.

framing.legend: The number by the first channel = its distance from the wall in cm.
framing.cutHint: Each line = one bar; «× count» means repeat the same cut. Pieces in cm with the room they go to.
framing.hangerCut: {total} pieces of {piece} cm: {per} from each bar, {offcut} cm offcut.
framing.footnote: The first channel and omega sit {grid} cm from the wall, and hangers are inside the channel only (the first one hanger-spacing from the wall); the edge angle carries the channel ends at the walls. Drawn from the priced quote version itself, so the counts of items in the bill of quantities match it.
framing.noneTotal: The survey was entered as total areas: the plan needs measured rooms. Add the rooms to the survey, then price the quote.
framing.noneProject: This project is on a quote version priced before the framing plan existed, and the quote is frozen after the contract. New projects get the plan.
framing.notListed: not in the bill of quantities
framing.notListedNote: Items marked «not in the bill of quantities» are supplied by the client or excluded from supply, but drawn for the technician.
framing.hangerLonger: {total} pieces of {piece} cm, longer than the bar ({bar} cm): each hanger needs a joint.
framing.footnoteOld: The first channel and omega sit {grid} cm from the wall. This version was priced before the «hangers inside the channel only» rule, so hangers are drawn at their priced count up to the channel ends.

maps.sitePinHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to the villa, press «My location» on site, or «From link» for a Google Maps link (short WhatsApp links too).
maps.pickLabel: Map to pick the project site
maps.pinNotSet: No location yet — if there's a link, it's read from it on save.
maps.gpsUnavailable: This device can't give its location.
maps.gpsDenied: Couldn't get your location — allow location for the app in the device settings.
maps.gpsWeak: Weak location accuracy (± {m} m) — check the pin and drag it to the right place.
maps.linkEmpty: Type the location link in the field above first.
maps.linkNoPin: Couldn't read a location from this link — set it on the map.
maps.linkFailed: Couldn't read the link — set the location on the map.
maps.noSiteYet: The project site isn't set — edit the client and set it on the map so the supervisor's visits can be measured.
maps.noSiteForVisits: The project site isn't set, so visit distances can't be measured — set it from the client page.
maps.projectsMapSub: Every running project on one map.
maps.noRunningBody: Accepted projects not yet handed over show here.
maps.withoutSiteHint: They show on the map once their site is set (from the project or client page).
maps.visitNoSite: The project site isn't set — no check-in before it is.
maps.visitInaccurate: Weak location accuracy — step outside or turn on GPS and try again.
maps.visitTooFar: You're {m} m from the project site — check-in works within {max} m only.
maps.noSiteSetHere: The project site isn't set — set it here so the supervisor can check in.
maps.siteIsClient: The site comes from the client — if the client has more than one project, set this project's site.
maps.projectSiteHint: For a client with more than one villa: set this project's own site. Supervisor check-ins are measured against it.
maps.pinFromLink: The site is read from the link on save.
maps.linkRateLimited: Too many tries — set the site on the map or try again shortly.
